descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT EFS states 3, 4, 5, 9, 10; TFA-94745 AC 3 · “Raw dictation kept, error shown, Generate disabled until Save succeeds (PR #53)”. Mixed: stated part — Summary, note, billing, offline and session-end failures show a message and keep the input; our part — Survives-a-reload checks and the 15 s / 20 s offline-banner timings (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S05 Existing chromium specs: summary, note, billing, offline and session-end failures keep the input and show a message (Hospital)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3a Pre-round summary failed: the raw dictation is kept, an error is shown, and Generate stays disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). (UAT EFS state 3; TFA-94745 state 3; TFA-92588 AC 8 (first sentence))
  • U4a Note generation failed: "Note not generated" is shown and the dictation is kept. (UAT EFS state 4; TFA-94745 state 4)
  • U5 Billing suggestion failed: the note is still shown and the billing area shows an error. (UAT EFS state 5; TFA-94745 state 5)
  • U9 Offline / no network: a clear "no network" message; the dictation is kept and retried when the connection returns (OAT-03). (UAT EFS state 9; TFA-94745 state 9; TFA-92568 Eng 4)
  • U10a Session expired mid-dictation: the dictation is kept, a sign-in prompt shows, and the dictation is available after signing back in. (UAT EFS state 10; TFA-94745 state 10)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state. (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 3)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's chromium specs: three mock one AI action to fail at the Convex socket (action-observer), one takes the browser offline, one revokes the session mid-dictation

When Run the five tests by title

Then Summary failure: the reviewed note text stays in the editor, a 'structured summary couldn’t be updated' message shows, Save Note stays available, all of it survives a reload. Note failure: a 'dictation is saved … note couldn’t' message, the dictation stays in the box and on the server, Generate stays available. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The specs' own assertions; spec-matrix.mjs names any failing test in the result. Not asserted by them: Generate disabled after a summary failure (S06, S07), the literal 'Note not generated' (S08, Q1), the note staying visible while billing fails after a real Generate (S09), dictation kept and saved after reconnect and AI steps tapped offline (S14), the other autosave fields (S …
